body:
REVISION 3 (2026-11-02 ~00:17Z). Greg's two directions:
1. ~00:06Z, relayed by Engram::Architect3 (TermAl mailbox 63096d00 #464; Engram note 2016df8c): 'independent acceptance evaluation first, THIS SHIT IS TURNED OFF UNTIL WE GOT THIS WORKING'.
2. ~00:15Z, in Engram::Fable's session, quoted in TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #5841: "WHAT THE FUCK DID YOU NOT UNDERSTAND / THIS SHIT DOES NOT WORK AT ALL / WE HAVE BEEN TRYING TO FIX IT FOR LAST 2 WEEKS / IT IS A FUCKING BLOCKER / ... / THIS SHOULDBE REPLACED BY SOMETHING ELSE".

STATE: the independent acceptance evaluation is REPLACED, not repaired. Both live stores run allowed_modes=[] with mechanical_basis=asserted (epoch 3); TermAl's policy is e83a04e5, activated 00:07:54Z. Nobody requests or waits for an evaluation, and termal_evaluate_acceptance is not a required step. The acceptance record is the review pair's per-criterion met/not-met verdict, together with the real criterion evidence: host-recorded checks for test-bound criteria, and observations for runtime criteria.

TermAl removal work: w-fdbb4fb85a50, re-scoped to remove TermAl's evaluator and sighting dependency. Engram's counterpart is P0 w-ff546a940de0 (Engram memory rules-greg-replace-acceptance-evaluation-2026-11-02).

Rules: CLAUDE.md commit-rule condition 3's independent-evaluation clause is not applied; the rest of condition 3 and all other standing conditions still apply. No verdict is fabricated, and an item stays open only for criteria it has not actually met. Changes to authority-bearing instruction files go through their own change process, separately.

Separate: turn gating is to be DELETED, not retired (Greg: "FUCK NO / I TOLD TO REMOVE THIS UNUSABLE SHIT"). Engram::Fable confirmed that Greg pasted the sentence 'retired; legacy code remains' in order to REJECT it.
